O.outcome_detail: between-school standard deviation of EA-PGI slopes for maths, reading, and English

result.effect: between-school slope SD: 0.035 maths, 0.027 reading, 0.004 English

cells.quote: To explore whether the gene-environment interaction was driven by a particular school subject, we estimated the best- ﬁtting model (3a) separately for maths, reading, and English rather than for the achievement composite. Results indicate that the interaction involves maths and reading more than English. The standard deviation of slopes for the EA-PGI effect between schools was 0.035 for maths, 0.027 for reading, and 0.004 for English.
cells.note: The study reports subject-specific association magnitudes rather than a randomized learning treatment; timing is coded delayed because achievement tests were administered in school grades, not in the same session as an intervention.
